# MOSS-VL-Realtime_Demo_App — vLLM-Omni TTS engine env (.venv-vllm)
# Once .venv-vllm exists, run_backend.sh
# DEFAULTS TTS_PROVIDER=vllm_omni (force the pytorch sidecar back with
# TTS_PROVIDER=moss_tts_nano); the backend spawns `.venv-vllm/bin/vllm serve
# <Nano ckpt> --omni` per placement TtsSpec (server/sidecars.py).
#
# SEPARATE venv, always: vllm pins torch==2.11.0 and its own transformers
# range, which conflict with the main .venv (transformers 4.57.1 for the
# MOSS-VL streaming code). Never install these into .venv.
#
# The GPU box is air-gapped — install OFFLINE from the pre-built wheelhouse
# (downloaded 2026-07-11 on the CPU box via its proxy; CUDA variant cu129 to
# match the H200 driver, which is what vllm 0.24.0's PyPI binaries are
# compiled against):
#
#   cd /inspire/hdd/project/video-understanding/public/personal/chwang/live/MOSS-VL-Realtime_Demo_App
#   python3.12 -m venv .venv-vllm
#   PIP_CONSTRAINT=/dev/null .venv-vllm/bin/pip install --no-index \
#       --find-links ../wheelhouse/vllm-omni -r requirements-vllm.txt
#   .venv-vllm/bin/vllm --version    # sanity
#
# PIP_CONSTRAINT=/dev/null is LOAD-BEARING on the GPU box: it runs an NGC
# PyTorch container image that globally constrains pip to the container's own
# torch build (torch==2.8.0a0+…nv25.6 via PIP_CONSTRAINT/pip.conf), which
# follows into fresh venvs and collides with vllm's torch==2.11.0 pin
# (ResolutionImpossible). /dev/null = empty constraints; it overrides both the
# env var and any pip.conf entry. Diagnose with: env | grep -i pip;
# pip config list.
#
# vllm-omni does NOT pip-depend on vllm — both must be pinned together
# (version-matched pair per the vLLM-Omni install docs).
#
# Wheelhouse floor: one wheel (cryptography) is manylinux_2_34 → the GPU box
# needs glibc >= 2.34 (Ubuntu 22.04+; `ldd --version`). Everything else is
# <= manylinux_2_28. nvidia-cutlass-dsl-libs-cu13 in the lock is vLLM's OWN
# pin (Requires-Dist: nvidia-cutlass-dsl[cu13]) — expected on the cu129 build.
#
# The vllm wheel in the house is the +cu129 GitHub-release variant
# (vllm-0.24.0+cu129-…whl). The bare PyPI vllm-0.24.0 wheel is a CUDA-13
# build — it imports fine at install time but dies at runtime with
# `ImportError: libcudart.so.13` on this CUDA 12.9 box. `vllm==0.24.0` below
# is satisfied by 0.24.0+cu129 (PEP 440 local versions match ==).
vllm==0.24.0
vllm-omni==0.24.0

# POST-INSTALL (REQUIRED for TTS_PROVIDER=moss_tts_realtime): after building
# this venv, run
#   .venv-vllm/bin/python scripts/patch_vllm_omni_moss_codec.py
# It is idempotent. vllm-omni 0.24.0's MOSS-Audio-Tokenizer codec loader builds
# 6 encoder/decoder projections as unconditional nn.Linear that the real
# checkpoint ships as nn.Identity() (equal dims) — so serving MOSS-TTS-Realtime
# otherwise dies with "MOSS Audio Tokenizer weights were not fully loaded:
# loaded=1600/1606". The patch makes them conditional-Identity (the checkpoint's
# true architecture). Upstream bug — not fixed in any release incl. 0.25.0rc1.
# The moss_tts_nano/vllm_omni provider does NOT need the patch.
